description: QuantApe's own per-symbol analytics for a stock screen — last earnings reaction and the drift since it, next earnings date with how much of that report is already priced in (expectations score) and the options-implied move, and recent technical signals (paged, max 200 per call). It returns no live quotes, market cap or valuation ratios; use a quote API for those. Descriptive, not a recommendation. Free within your daily allowance (anonymous 5/day by IP, signed-in users 10/day, power users 50/day); beyond that $0.05 per call via x402 (USDC).

list_id.description: Screen id from list_smart_lists (e.g. day_gainers, golden_cross, ai_beneficiaries).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the screen for paging.

name: get_smart_list_metrics

earnings_reaction_date.description: Session of the last earnings reaction, YYYY-MM-DD — the anchor for earnings_reaction_percent and since_earnings_percent

earnings_reaction_percent.description: Largest single-session move around the last report, measured on earnings_reaction_date; % points (7.04 = +7.04%)

expectations_bar_score.description: 0-100, how much of an earnings move is priced in ahead of next_earnings_date (descriptive, not directional)

implied_move_pct.description: Options-implied earnings move for next_earnings_date, 1 sigma; % points (7.04 = +7.04%)

next_earnings_date.description: ISO 8601 UTC — the event expectations_bar_score and implied_move_pct are measured for

since_earnings_percent.description: Close after the last report to the latest stored quote (refreshed on a priority queue, so it can lag a session); % points (7.04 = +7.04%)

technical_signals.description: Recent signals with their own date each, typically {date, type, name, strength, price}
